Notes:- During vibration recording the following precautions need to be under taken:-
a) Steady course and regime should be maintained.
b) Wheel over five degrees should be avoided.
c) Gun trials / helo operation / maneuvering to be avoided during the course of vibration signature recording.
d) Sl no. 10 will be undertaken during FPT.
